ascvd_population.long_name: Total population of the area reported alongside the ASCVD risk snapshot
ascvd_population.short_description: Total population of the geography as reported alongside the ASCVD risk outcome.
ascvd_population.long_description: Total population denominator reported for a given ZCTA3, state, or national area alongside the ASCVD risk snapshot. Provided for context, not as an independent outcome measure. Time period represented: 01/01/2022 – 07/31/2025. The `time` value in the standard data is the last date of this period (2025-07-31).

ascvd_risk_low.long_name: Lower bound of the aggregate of 10-year risk of heart attack and stroke for people aged 40-70
ascvd_risk_low.short_description: Lower bound (percent) of the ASCVD risk range for this area.
ascvd_risk_low.long_description: ASCVD (heart attack and stroke) risk for the 40-70 age range is reported only as only as a range, never as a single point value. This is the numeric lower bound of that range, in percent. Use alongside ascvd_risk_high and ascvd_risk_label -- do not average low/high into a point estimate. Time period represented: 01/01/2022 – 07/31/2025. The `time` value in the standard data is the last date of this period (2025-07-31).
ascvd_risk_low.statement: In {location}, aggregate 10-year ASCVD risk fell between {value}% and {ascvd_risk_high}%.

ascvd_risk_high.long_name: Upper bound of the aggregate 10-year risk of heart attack and stroke for people aged 40-70
ascvd_risk_high.short_description: Upper bound (percent) of the ASCVD risk range for this area.
ascvd_risk_high.long_description: Numeric upper bound of the same range described in ascvd_risk_low. See that field's description for the range-vs-point-estimate caveat. Time period represented: 01/01/2022 – 07/31/2025. The `time` value in the standard data is the last date of this period (2025-07-31).
ascvd_risk_high.statement: In {location}, aggregate 10-year ASCVD risk fell between {ascvd_risk_low}% and {value}%.

ascvd_risk_label.long_name: Qualitative label for the ASCVD 10-year risk, relative to the national average
ascvd_risk_label.short_description: Text label describing this area's ASCVD risk relative to the national average.
ascvd_risk_label.long_description: A qualitative classification of the ASCVD risk, ranging from "Low Outlier" through "High Outlier", or "No Data" where the area had no reportable rate. Time period represented: 01/01/2022 – 07/31/2025. The `time` value in the standard data is the last date of this period (2025-07-31).
ascvd_risk_label.statement: In {location}, ASCVD risk was classified as "{value}".

_catalog.name: 10-Year ASCVD Risk
_catalog.summary: Area-level ranges for the 10-year risk of heart attack and stroke in adults ages 40-70. Values are given as ranges, not exact numbers.

veradigm.name: 10-year ASCVD risk
veradigm.description: Data for the 10-year Atherosclerotic Cardiovascular Disease (ASCVD) risk score are provided by Veradigm from multiple sources using the Veradigm Network Electronic Health Record (EHR) database for patients with all data elements necessary for score calculation. These data cover the period 01/01/2022-07/31/2025. It is important to note that the data displayed are not intended to represent the entire US population.
veradigm.restrictions: Data can be reused with attribution of data from Veradigm, obtained via the PopHIVE platform (https://github.com/PopHIVE/Ingest).
